text_to_image_prompt: Photorealistic adult male with warm fair skin and visible pores, gray-blue eyes, thick natural brows, straight nose, full pink lips, defined jaw and light brown airy tousled wavy hair. Tall slim natural approximately seven-head proportions, navy textured band collar shirt, white inner placket, light gray striped turned cuffs, necklace, black pinstripe wide trousers, cloth sash and black shoes. Pure white background, crisp neutral soft studio photography, same identity in all panels. Square 3x3 expression sheet, NINE large front-facing head-and-shoulder portraits: neutral, gentle closed-mouth smile, amused playful smirk; natural laugh, concerned, surprised; restrained annoyance, sad, affectionate gaze. Same identity and hair in every panel, varied subtle believable muscle movement. Navy shirt from the described outfit. No exaggerated grimaces.
original_prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Repair the third image (edit target) against image1 exact identity master and image2 approved body/outfit master. Same adult man, no redesign. Match image1 face width, cheek fullness, jaw/chin shape, brow-eye spacing, straight nose, full lips, gray-blue irises, subtle skin marks, light brown soft airy waves and flyaways. Do not elongate face, narrow cheeks or sharpen chin. Preserve natural camera skin pores and individual fine hair, no doll/CGI/smoothing. Same navy textured band-collar shirt, white inner placket and small necklace as image2; unchanged white studio background and neutral illumination. Match head-to-shoulder proportion to approved references, no oversized head. Nine portraits 3x3: neutral, restrained smile, playful sideways glance, open laugh, worried, surprise, angry, sad, warm tilted smile. Keep facial bone structure constant under natural expressions, especially jaw width and eye spacing. Preserve layout. Render genuinely detailed 3072x3072 high resolution with photographic skin texture and fine eyelashes in each panel.
